name: ZPS_SYNC_ERRORS
description: Table to capture error details of synchronization of appointments, contacts, tasks and emails with Microsoft.

columns.name: SYNC_ERROR_ID
columns.description: The primary key of the table.

columns.name: PRODUCER_ID
columns.description: The reference ID of the user or application, which is doing the synchronization.

columns.name: SYNC_TYPE
columns.description:
Three types of synchronization: 

0 - Standard synchronization 
1 - Instant synchronization 
2 - Email synchronization.

columns.name: MSG_TYPE
columns.description: The type of error message: System or User

columns.name: SYNC_DIRECTION
columns.description: The two directions of synchronization: Up sync and Down sync.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE
columns.description: The object type such as appointment or contact.

columns.name: OPERATION_TYPE
columns.description: The operation type such as create, update, or delete.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: The Record ID in the sales application.

columns.name: RECORD_NUMBER
columns.description: The record number in the sales application.

columns.name: SYNC_ID
columns.description: The foreign key to the table, ZPS_SYNC.

columns.name: MS_ID
columns.description: Id of the Microsoft record.

columns.name: OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the failed record.

columns.name: IS_OWNER_ACTION
columns.description: Flag to indicate that the action on the record was done by the owner.

columns.name: ERROR_SEVERITY
columns.description: The severity of an error.

columns.name: ERROR_REASON
columns.description: The reason for an error.

columns.name: ERROR_STACKTRACE
columns.description: The stack trace of an error.

columns.name: ERROR_ADDL_DETAILS
columns.description: The column that stores additional data related to the Microsoft errors.

columns.name: HTTP_URL
columns.description: Component of Microsoft error details: HTTP URL.

columns.name: HTTP_HEADERS
columns.description: Component of Microsoft error details: HTTP headers.

columns.name: HTTP_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Component of Microsoft error details: HTTP status code.

columns.name: HTTP_REASON_PHRASE
columns.description: Component of Microsoft error details: HTTP reason phrase.

columns.name: FULL_MESSAGE
columns.description: The non-translated version of an error message.

columns.name: PAYLOAD
columns.description: The payload of a failed record.

columns.name: DISPLAY_MESSAGE
columns.description: Formatted error message.

columns.name: IS_AUTO_SYNC
columns.description: Flag to indicate that an error occurred during an automatic synchronization.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
